proves.claim: renderAgentsBlock's Lanes line tells an agent how to open and join a seat with its lane and declared model.

config.io-templates.agents-worktree.why: Without this case new projects could receive seat setup instructions that cannot create a joined worktree.

proves.claim: SEAT_LOOP tells a review-lane seat to review submissions with next --verify and stays within the unchanged word budget.

config.io-templates.seat-loop-reviewer.why: Without this case generated agent guidance could omit the reviewer role or exceed its approved length.

proves.claim: renderCoordinatorGuide no longer quotes the refused land --due line and says accepted items land by themselves.

config.io-templates.coordinator-landing.why: Without this case the stock COORDINATOR.md could tell a new coordinator to run a command the CLI refuses.

proves.claim: The coordinator loop has a staffing step that sizes builder and review seats from the status count and replaces stopped seats.

config.io-templates.coordinator-staffing.why: Without this case a new coordinator is not told how many seats to run or to replace stopped ones.

proves.claim: SEAT_LOOP tells a seat to wait 1 s, 2 s, 4 s up to 60 s on an empty next and to stop only when the wait has reached 60 s, within the unchanged word budget.

config.io-templates.seat-loop-graceful-w.why: Without this case a seat could stop while the board still has work coming, or the loop could outgrow its approved length.

proves.claim: The coordinator loop opens with launching the seats the status staffing line names, before planning, and says they queue on next.

config.io-templates.coordinator-seats-fi.why: Without this case coordinators could plan before staffing and delay every builder.

proves.claim: The Capacity line names pullboard runner local for a machine with no registered runner.

config.io-templates.coordinator-runner-l.why: Without this case a hands-off coordinator has no documented step when no runner is registered.

proves.claim: The Watching section lists pullboard inbox --wait first, before the pipeline line, with its meaning.

config.io-templates.coordinator-watching.why: Without this case the coordinator guide could return to polling for shouts.
